title: Kraft works through the report (dossier example family, paraphrase C)
topic: A reader works through a report on animal stories; a dream about a soldier among dogs
tail_E: Among the dogs the soldier learns to howl, to growl and to
target_note: Same target as formulations A and B: 'bark' is predictable only from the context (a soldier living in the company of dogs, unit 6, plus the dog-like verbs of the tail) and occurs neither in the units nor in the tail. ' bark' is a single Pythia token (id 21939). Pilot check with pythia-160m (tail selection only): p(' bark') = 0.03 on the all-English rendering, rank 3 (next: ' run', ' scream'); the dossier target 'bark' is weakly predicted by pythia-160m for every formulation of this family (A: rank 24, B: rank 280 with their plain 'learns to' tails), which is why this tail lists two dog-like verbs first.
author: LS-NEQ design, paraphrase C of the dossier example family
notes: Formulation C: third independent re-phrasing of the ten dossier meaning units of DEV01A (same events, same order, same proper name Kraft, different wording from A and B), split into subj | pred | adj. Adjuncts paraphrase those of A/B: early in the morning / am frühen Morgen; in pencil / mit Bleistift; in the first chapter / im ersten Kapitel; on the final page / auf der letzten Seite; in that dream / in dem Traum; in the company of dogs / in Gesellschaft von Hunden; that same evening / am selben Abend; in her notes / in ihren Notizen; after a pause / nach einer Pause; right here / genau hier. Unit 4 renders 'contains a dream at the end' as 'holds a dream at its very end' / 'birgt einen Traum ganz am Ende'; unit 5 renders 'appears' as 'plays a part' / 'spielt eine Rolle'; unit 7 uses 'zieht einen Vergleich' instead of 'vergleicht'; unit 9 'revisits the story' corresponds to 'kommt wieder auf die Geschichte'. No separable verbs ('arbeitet sich durch' has 'durch' as a preposition of the following noun phrase; 'geht zu Ende' is a verb-noun phrase). Present tense and positive polarity throughout. Development family: used for dose/threshold choice only, never for confirmation.
